languages.implementation: Server-side dictionary in lib/i18n.js, explicit equivalent-language routes, lang query and tenant-scoped pwa_lang cookie. Inline text overrides text_KEY_LANG are merged for every render. Domain content has French and English columns.

pages.job: Explain the single-provider installation and after-sales journey.
Explain sale, installation, maintenance, repair, warranty and parts.
Store a quote request and report notification acceptance honestly.
Collect an authenticated appointment request, not a confirmed booking.
Read and cancel the current account’s requests.
Describe implemented information handling; owner must validate before launch.

redirects.from: Known public route with a different selected language
redirects.to: Equivalent localized route, preserving scalar query parameters

source.verification: The original URL was opened during preparation; its readable live response exposed navigation only. Detailed business claims come from the owner-authorized supplied extraction, not newly verified operational promises.

assets.role: Unmodified company logo, rendered within a white reserve
Excluded Outlook screenshot; not a public site image
Small badge, withheld pending visual and authorization review

boundaries: No original backend, calendar or mail integration was imported.
No verified usable installation photographs were supplied; the hero is typographic and diagrammatic.
Only the original generatrice path was explicitly retained. Other old navigation destinations were not inferred.
Company and Generac logos are not redrawn or recoloured. The secondary SVG favicon is a distinct diagrammatic mark.
No five-year universal warranty, model catalogue, pricing, stock counts, operating hours, exact address or guaranteed one-day installation is asserted.

design.signature: A static white service line connects ordered stages. Real process numbers use 1–4, never decorative zero-padding.
design.brandResolution: The neutral concept is retained; the explicit primary-brand contract uses blue for primary quote/send buttons and platform theming. The masthead appointment button and service diagram remain white.

features.admin: Gated dashboard, module discovery, server-rendered module pages, client filtering/sorting/pagination, validated CRUD dialogs, image upload and illustrative generation.
features.quotes: Anonymous or authenticated database-first requests, idempotency key, field validation, bounded attempt limiter and optional business email notification.
features.appointments: OTP-based platform authentication, service reason, optional date/time preferences, review step and saved-request confirmation. There is no connected calendar and no availability claim.
features.account: Authenticated own-record list and conditional cancellation; quote history includes only quotes submitted while authenticated.
features.push: Built-in pre-permission UI after eight seconds plus a meaningful interaction, only when notifications are enabled; explicit footer opt-in.
features.install: Built-in install banner; service-worker registration and offline caching are platform-owned.
features.visits: Path and timestamp only; excludes admin and API requests. Operational visit data is not a content module.
features.privacy: Cancel preserves history; admin deletion removes request rows. Retention and broader platform privacy terms need owner validation.

technical.user_id: Derived from authenticated platform user only

appointment.review: public/js/request.js renders a text-only summary before the second submit.

forms.preservation: Future removal of a form field must preserve its database column and historical values.

services.database: services.db get/all/run with awaited PostgreSQL statements
services.auth: services.auth.optionalAuth on pages; requireAuth on personal APIs; TenantSDK auto-wired login and authenticated fetch
services.admin: services.admin.isAdmin on every admin page and API via middleware, plus explicit dashboard gate
services.email: services.email.send, recipient services.config.contactEmail, replyTo requester email; disabled until mail_delivery_enabled is explicitly enabled
services.crypto: services.crypto.randomUUID for references and idempotency tokens

setup.contacts: Public installation contact fields intentionally start empty; public after-sales contact fields are seeded only from business config, never the account email. Confirm source business contacts in admin/settings.
setup.seedSignature: seed.js accepts db and optional services; if only db is supplied by the seed runner, business contact fields remain safely absent and can be set in admin/settings.
setup.mail: Set platform business contactEmail, configure internal routing for installation versus after-sales notification subjects, then enable mail_delivery_enabled. Editing public addresses does not alter notification delivery.
setup.calendar: No calendar service is connected or falsely claimed. Add a supported, owner-approved calendar with real availability before converting requests into instant booking.
setup.photography: Commission real installation and equipment photos. Any vector evolution of the company logo requires separate approval.

safeSmokeScenarios.text: One installation. One point of contact.

mutationTestPlan.executionStatus: Not executed in this generation environment
mutationTestPlan.isolation: Use a disposable tenant database. Keep mail_delivery_enabled=false and inject stubs for services.email.send, services.cloudinary.uploader.upload and services.ai.generateImage. Never test with live recipients or billable generation.
scenarios: Valid quote stores once; repeat request_key returns the same reference without sending again.
Invalid email returns 422 with field errors; no request is stored.
Authenticated appointment records preferences but no confirmed reservation.
A second user cannot read or cancel the first user’s requests.
Owner CRUD creates, edits and deletes each content module; public published content reflects changes.
With a stub email rejection, the request stays stored and the visitor sees a saved-but-unverified notification message.
With a stub successful send and explicit mail enable, the visitor sees accepted-notification wording, never confirmed-booking wording.
Changing FR/EN preserves page and appointment motif.
